summary: It records the format and schema location without decoding the bytes, allowing engines to interpret the data while preserving the original payload. Participants question whether this truly extends PME, which currently protects at module boundaries, and call for clarification of scope and implementation details. Participants decide to include Delta mode, rename the proposal to FastLanes, and plan future work on interleaving and Unified Transpose Layout. By using a modular footer, the layout preserves row‑group statistics for efficient data skipping while allowing writers to buffer and emit pages based on column size and density, improving performance for wide, sparse, or asymmetric schemas.
